verdict.rationale: Data residency or region selection is a fair question for a SaaS financial API like Stripe Issuing, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any choice of storage region or data residency. The country-based spending controls restrict where merchants can be charged, not where data is stored, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
